events.arrival-white-sea: Arrival at the White Sea; Gan Fall saves the crew from Wyper's attack.
events.luffy-defeats-satori: Luffy defeats Priest Satori in the Lost Forest.
events.gan-fall-vs-shura: Gan Fall loses to Shura while defending the Going Merry.
events.enel-first-appearance: Enel's first appearance before his priests.
events.zoro-vs-braham: Zoro defeats Braham during the Survival Game.
events.luffy-vs-wyper: Luffy faces Wyper and his Burn Bazooka.
events.luffy-defeats-gedatsu: Luffy defeats Priest Gedatsu in the swamp.
events.enel-goro-goro-reveal: Enel reveals his power: the Goro Goro no Mi, a lightning Logia.
events.zoro-defeats-ohm: Zoro defeats Priest Ohm in the Upper Ruins.
events.wyper-reject-enel: Wyper uses the Reject Dial on Enel, who revives himself with his own lightning.
events.ark-maxim-reveal: Enel shows off the ark Maxim and his plan to travel to Fairy Vearth.
events.luffy-vs-enel-rubber: Luffy takes on Enel and turns out to be immune to his lightning because he is made of rubber.
events.noland-kalgara-friendship: Flashback to the friendship between Noland and Calgara, 400 years ago.
events.luffy-golden-arm: Luffy uses the golden ball stuck to his arm as a weapon against Enel.
events.luffy-defeats-enel: Luffy defeats Enel with the Gomu Gomu no Ougon Rifle and rings the golden bell.
events.robin-roger-poneglyph: Robin reads the Poneglyph on the bell and discovers Gol D. Roger's message.
events.straw-hats-take-gold: The crew takes gold from Shandora and descends to the Blue Sea.
